span.p:
EVERY BOX = the SAME certified
compare-exchange organ:
one comparator + two muxes,
outputs (min, max) — the tropical pair.
5 CEs, depth 3. The 8×8 = 19 CEs, depth 6
(batcher8_sorts, kernel-certified).
